components.css: .ds-work-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:24px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #e4e6e1; text-decoration:none; color:#1c1f1c; transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-work-row:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 6px 24px -8px rgba(20,24,20,0.18); } .ds-work-title { font:600 1.375rem/1.1 'General Sans',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; margin:0 0 6px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; position:relative; } .ds-work-title::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-2px; height:2px; width:100%; background:#5e7f3a; clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0); transition:clip-path .3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-title { color:#5e7f3a; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-title::after { clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0); } .ds-work-arrow { opacity:0; transform:translateX(-6px); transition:opacity .18s,transform .18s; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-arrow { opacity:1; transform:translateX(0); } .ds-work-desc { font:400 1rem/1.6 'General Sans',sans-serif; color:#6e716c; margin:0 0 12px; max-width:60ch; } .ds-work-tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { font:500 .8125rem/1.4 'Geist Mono',monospace; background:#f6f7f5; color:#6e716c; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:999px; transition:color .18s,transform .18s; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-chip { color:#1c1f1c; } .ds-work-award { font:500 .8125rem/1.4 'Geist Mono',monospace; color:#6e716c; white-space:nowrap; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .ds-work-row,.ds-work-title::after,.ds-work-arrow,.ds-chip{ transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: A page that reads like a precision instrument's faceplate — exact, quiet, load-bearing. 90% calm, 10% signature. The moss-green accent is rationed to interaction states only; the craft concentrates in one hover interaction (the Selected-Work row). The site is itself the work sample — speed, correctness, and restraint are the argument.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial-typographic base, but sans-driven (no serif) — dodges the saturated magazine lane
Near-monochrome; a single rationed moss-green accent carries all hue
Metadata set in Geist Mono as real engineering texture
Speed and correctness treated as design features

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The moss-green accent appears on ≤10% of any screen and only on interaction states. If green is visible before you hover/focus/activate, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Neutral Ground Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are chroma 0 (dark) or pure white (light). Hue lives exclusively in the accent.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Metadata Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is only for real data — dates, tags, indices, status. Never headings, body, or decoration.

rules.name: The No-Italic-Serif Rule
rules.body: No serif, no italic display. The moment a Fraunces-style italic headline appears, the page has collapsed into the saturated editorial lane.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only as a response to hover/focus.

dos: Do keep the accent on ≤10% of any screen, only on interaction states
Do keep backgrounds neutral — pure white or near-black chroma 0
Do set all metadata in Geist Mono, headings/body in General Sans
Do make Selected Work a hairline-separated list of rows with one crafted hover
Do ease with exponential out-curves, 150–250ms hover, no bounce
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every animation
Do treat speed as a design feature: near-zero JS, self-hosted fonts, no layout shift
donts: Don't use purple/blue gradient-mesh or floating-blob hero backgrounds
Don't use glassmorphism or gradient text
Don't apply uniform fade-up-on-scroll to every section
Don't build the SaaS hero-metric template
Don't repeat identical icon-card grids or tracked eyebrows / 01 02 03 markers on every section
Don't reintroduce the auto-scrolling skills marquee — use a static hover grid
Don't drift into the editorial-magazine lane: no italic serif, no ruled broadsheet grid
Don't use mono for anything but genuine metadata
Don't write hype copy — lead with real numbers
